units: <cite ref="Berakhot 8a:30">Ber. 8ᵃ</cite> <he>ש׳ מקרא ואחד תרגום</he> reading the Scriptural portion of the week twice, and the Targum once.
<cite ref="Berakhot 8a:30">Ib.</cite> <he>שיעור ש׳ פתחים</he> a distance of two gates.
<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 1:1">Sabb. I, 1</cite> <he>ש׳ שהן ארבע</he> two ways of transfer from place to place, which become four (by rabbinical addition).
<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 1:1">Ib.</cite> <he>שְׁנֵיהֶם פטורין</he> both of them are free.
<cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 5:3">Snh. V, 3</cite> <he>בש׳ בחדש</he> on the second day of the month.
<cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 5:3">Ib.</cite> <he>בש׳ שעות</he> in the second hour of the day.
Ib. 6; a. v. fr.—שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר, שְׁתֵּים עֶשְׂרֵה twelve.
